general: Extract every entity of the supplied types. Return exact spans from the query. Leave other text unlabelled.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Refers to a music-related occurrence or happening, such as a concert, festival, or competition.
rules: EV1 Examples: "2003 World Championships in Athletics", "Vocal Event of the Year", "World War II", "Saint Patrick 's Day", "the first wave of glam metal".

classes.name: Award
classes.description: Refers to a device or tool used to produce musical sounds, such as a piano, guitar, or drum.
rules: AW1 Examples: "Grammy Award", "Brit Awards", "MTV Video Music Award", "Academy Awards", "Grammy Award for Best Alternative Music Album".

classes.name: Band
classes.description: Refers to a distinct category or style of music, characterized by its unique characteristics, themes, and instrumentation.

classes.name: Location
classes.description: Refers to a specific geographical or structural location.
rules: LO1 This includes but is not limited to: places (e.g., parks, landmarks), bridges, cities, towns, villages, areas and other distinct regions.
LO2 Examples: "Europe", "Stade de France", "Paris", "Théâtre de la Ville", "Bay Area".

classes.name: Other
classes.description: Refers to named entities that are not included in any other category.

classes.name: MusicalInstrument
classes.description: Refers to a device or tool used to produce musical sounds, such as a piano, guitar, or drum.
rules: MI1 Examples: "piano accordion", "six-string guitar banjo", "guitar", "keyboard", "bass guitar".

classes.name: Person
classes.description: Refers to an individual's name that is not a musical artist.
rules: PE1 Examples: "Barney Bubbles", "Stéphane Lafarge", "Bubbles", "Wolf-Rüdiger Mühlmann", "Glen Campbell".

classes.name: Album
classes.description: Refers to a collection of songs or musical compositions released as a single package
rules: AL1 Examples: "American Idiot", "Dookie", "Sun Ra Visits Planet Earth", "Interstellar Low Ways", "Super-Sonic Jazz".

classes.name: MusicalArtist
classes.description: Refers to an individual actively involved in the creation, performance, or production of music.
rules: MA1 If a person is a singer, composer, or songwriter, annotate them as a musical artist entity instead of a person entity

classes.name: MusicGenre
classes.description: Refers to a distinct category or style of music, characterized by its unique characteristics, themes, and instrumentation.
rules: MG1 Include regional musics typical of a certain place.
MG2 Examples: "Hip hop music", "Pop music", "reggae", "Punk rock", "Celtic rock".

classes.name: Song
classes.description: Refers to a distinct category or style of music, characterized by its unique characteristics, themes, and instrumentation.
rules: SO1 Examples: "Is That Love", "Tempted", "Clubland", "New Lace Sleeves", "The Lunatics ( Have Taken Over the Asylum )".

classes.name: Organization
classes.description: Refers to a structured group, institution, company, or association.
rules: OR1 This category covers a diverse range of organizations, including businesses, non-profits, educational institutions, and government agencies.
OR2 Examples: "Recording Industry Association of America", "Billboard", "BBC News", "Academy of Country Music", "Country Music Association".
